acceptanceCriteria: A deadline overrun in the dogfood-change impact step yields a visible NOT_OBSERVED/abstention or one bounded retry instead of exit 2.
The deadline value and any override are documented and tested.
A test reproduces the overrun with an injected slow git.
body: Observed 2026-10-17 in lane gh-tasks3 (PR #1076), load 55-95 on 12 cores: coordination-time-impact exited 2 'Git repository index exceeded its deadline' on ~20 of 22 tries; the diff-tree --find-copies-harder took 13-33 s against the hard-coded 30 s gitDeadline (internal/contextindex/git.go:26), which has no override. dogfood-change does not retry and the exit is not an admitted abstention, so each miss cost a ~20 min rerun. Expected: a bounded deadline-overrun degrades to a recorded abstention/NOT_OBSERVED or a single bounded retry, or the deadline is configurable within a recorded bound.
title: dogfood-change: contextindex 30s gitDeadline exits 2 under host load with no retry or admitted abstention
